\label{lesson:KA-C95-notpossible}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for a plate, then the Kannada for the price.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ}}
\textbf{\kn{ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ}} (\emph{sādhyavilla}) — \textquotedblleft{}it's not possible\textquotedblright{}, from \textbf{\kn{ಸಾಧ್ಯ}} (\emph{sādhya}), \textquotedblleft{}possible\textquotedblright{}, with \textbf{‑\kn{ಇಲ್ಲ}}, \textquotedblleft{}not\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
Possible, and the no that closes it.
\end{grammarlens}

The sure answer after maybe.
